summary: Split out of MPI-579 as MPI-553 phase 1, on Fabio's prompt and over the objection that a mechanism must not ride on a product card - MPI-506 proved the failure by taking the unbuilt mechanism down with SeedVR2. Three extensions to a plugin entity currently shaped for one right-click text action: (1) contribute an ENTRY to the EXISTING MpiToolOptionsUpscale dropdown, both image and video kinds, not a new dropdown; (2) a selected entry contributes its own CONTROLS with a hidden 0-1 mapping, generic because PiD needs it too; (3) a Flow can REQUIRE a plugin (MPI-557 adopts the LTX upscaler) and a plugin can SHARE deps with a ModelDef. On (3b): ltx23-spatial-upscaler is ALREADY an assetDep, already on R2 and already in both LTX tiers' dependencies, so an LTX user needs zero extra download and the plugin derives to installed for free - but a non-LTX user faces a plugin whose install is the whole LTX stack, which needs a product answer. GC is the sharp edge: a dep owned by both a plugin and a model must survive either owner, and both twins get fixed in one pass.
